document: Names that are not a person's: the reviewed list of the runner lookup (lead decision D24.6). A result is not listed when the producer flags its name as a placeholder (unlinked_reason = placeholder_name in the person-links file), or when the set of its search words equals the set of search words of a name below (analysis/lookup_names.py: a trailing country code dropped, accents and case aside, word order and repeats aside). The results stay in the release, the cohort and the analyses. A name is on the list only when its own words say it is not a person's name; initials and one-letter names ("N N", "X X", "N A", "M Name") were read and left off.
counts: release_rows is the number of rows of pace-notes-marathon-half-20261113-1113, both distances, flagged or not, whose search words equal the name's (measured 2026-11-14). The builder recounts each and stops on a difference: read the difference, then update the count.
